The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2e99bf33c152d2e2), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 13-14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: For every finitely generated group G with decidable word problem, there is a nonzero finitely presented unital F2-algebra B with the following properties. (i) There is an injective nonunital algebra endomorphism ϕ : B → B. With p = ϕ(1) there are s0, s1, d0, d1 ∈ pBp, centralizing ϕ(B), such that disj = δijp, s0d0 + s1d1 = p. (3.5) (ii) Form Q, X, W, Y, ι, ιX and jℓ,E as above. There is a nonzero idempotent e ∈ B such that G and W embed in (eBe)×. There are Sy, Ty ∈ eBe, for all y ∈ Y , with TySz = δyze, wSy = Swy, Tyw = Tw−1y. (3.6) Here w denotes its corner-unit image. 13 The two diagrams have common full-identity map ι and satisfy Equation (3.4).
